title: Neural Equation Finder
subtitle: Upload data. Train a neural predictor. Inspect a polynomial surrogate.
instructions: Use the built-in sample or upload a numeric CSV, then choose one target and one to four input features.
Choose the model settings and press Train; measured progress and any convergence warning appear in the workspace.
Compare held-out predictions, residuals, and equation fidelity before interpreting the polynomial surrogate.
objectives: Select numeric features and a scalar target.
Distinguish polynomial fidelity from neural predictive quality.
assumptions: Numeric tabular regression with 1–4 features and 20–5,000 usable rows.
Training-only standardization and a deterministic held-out split.
The explicit equation approximates the neural network; it does not establish a governing law.
